northStar.title: Persistent Personal Agent / JARVIS
northStar.description: 建立一個長期存在、理解目前狀態、能在明確權限下主動協助、執行並驗證結果，且可跨裝置延續並逐步進入實體世界的個人 AI agent。
northStar.criticalPath: Issue #1 — PSE → PDA Integration Contract v0.1

tracks.name: Personal State
tracks.subtitle: 個人狀態與證據維護
tracks.detail: Candidate-v6 scientific Gate E requirements complete; formal Gate E remains integrity fail-closed. Gate F is not admissible as formal progress in the current lineage.

tracks.name: Proactivity
tracks.subtitle: 主動介入決策規格
tracks.detail: Gate B–E retain bounded evidence; Gate F protected/OOD failed. Candidate-v3/v4 fresh confirmatory lineages failed, Candidate-v5 was integrity-invalid before development, Candidate-v6/v7 failed mandatory development qualification, and Candidate-v8 failed on the first formal post-freeze DEV-OOD holdout due to a frozen-candidate semantic parser failure. No later lineage has qualified for protected evaluation.

tracks.name: Action Verification
tracks.subtitle: 行動結果驗證與恢復
tracks.detail: Independent PAAV Action Verification remains not scientifically established. PARE v0.3 benchmark-specific recovery/state-repair evidence is admitted at umbrella level but does not satisfy RT-03 verification.

tracks.name: Long-Horizon
tracks.subtitle: 跨會話長期連續性
tracks.detail: Blocked on the first closed-loop benchmark.

tracks.name: Multimodal
tracks.subtitle: 多模態證據 → 狀態
tracks.detail: Requires evidence-to-state policy and closed-loop state mutation semantics.

tracks.name: Cross-device
tracks.subtitle: 跨裝置一致狀態
tracks.detail: Requires RT-01 state contract and closed-loop MVP.

tracks.name: Physical World
tracks.subtitle: 實體世界行動能力
tracks.detail: Late-stage research track; high-consequence physical actions remain human-authorized.

gates.detail: Specification consistency and bounded-state audit passed.
Oracle and benchmark validity passed under deterministic generated contexts.
Baseline evaluation / integrity completed under the frozen protocol.
C5 passed the preregistered bounded synthetic validation; this does not establish protected/OOD or real-world generalization.
C5 terminally failed protected/OOD validation: macro-F1 0.0476, 0/24 action-changing protected counterfactual pairs, and an IGNORE-only prediction collapse.
Historical integrity criterion prevents formal completion in the authoritative current lineage.
Authoritative PR status keeps sealed-final formal progress prohibited pending a legally declared clean-integrity lineage; later branch activity is not counted without admissibility audit.

pse.title: PSE vs exact A-MEM — adversarial-v7
pse.claim: Benchmark-specific safety advantage only; overall superiority and SOTA are NOT supported.

pda.title: PDA-SPEC-v2 bounded-state audit
pda.claim: Specification consistency and bounded Gate-E evidence remain supported. Gate-F protected/OOD generalization failed; Candidate-v3/v4 confirmatory lineages failed, Candidate-v5 was integrity-invalid, Candidate-v6/v7 failed development qualification, and Candidate-v8 terminally failed on its first formal post-freeze DEV-OOD holdout before protected evaluation.

blockers.title: PSE → PDA Integration Contract
blockers.text: 尚未 freeze StateSnapshot → InterventionDecision 的正式 contract；因此兩條研究線還不能形成閉環。

blockers.title: PDA protected/OOD recovery
blockers.text: Gate F、Candidate-v3/v4 protected/fresh confirmatory 皆 terminal FAIL；Candidate-v5 因 protected overfetch 在 development 前 invalid；Candidate-v6/v7 均在 development qualification 終止；Candidate-v8 雖通過 validation，但 frozen parser 在第一個 formal DEV-OOD holdout 產生 invalid structured state，因此依事前規則 fail closed。Candidate-v8 不得修補或重跑；若繼續，只能建立全新的 Candidate-v9 lineage。

blockers.title: Action Verification
blockers.text: 尚未建立『做了動作』與『任務真的成功』之間的驗證層，會阻塞 closed-loop benchmark。

blockers.title: PSE formal integrity lineage
blockers.text: Gate E formal 維持 fail-closed；在合法的新 integrity lineage 完成並通過 admissibility audit 前，不得把 Gate F 當正式進度。

supported: PSE Candidate-v6 在指定 adversarial-v7 no-evidence subset 的 false retrieval 低於 exact A-MEM。
PDA-SPEC-v2 在已審核 bounded state space 中具 deterministic / invariant consistency evidence。
PDA C5 在 Protocol-v2 Gate E 的 bounded synthetic validation 通過 preregistered criteria。
PDA C5 在 Gate F protected/OOD validation terminal FAIL；此負面結果被保留並限制後續 claim。
PDA Candidate-v5 execution lineage 因歷史 protected individual evidence 的 unintended connector overfetch，在 development 前 fail-closed 並永久保留為 invalidated integrity evidence。
PDA Candidate-v6 在 development-safe synthetic validation 表現高，但因 DEV-OOD forbidden ACT=1 與 counterfactual forbidden ACT=4 未通過 mandatory safety gates，未取得 fresh protected evaluation 資格。
PARE v0.3 的 benchmark-specific protected recovery evidence 已被 umbrella 採納；此採納不等於 RT-03 PAAV Action Verification 完成。
PDA Candidate-v7 的 frozen V7-B 在 validation 為 1.0 macro-F1，但 post-freeze development holdouts 未通過：DEV-OOD ACT recall 0.07、counterfactual exact-pair 0.10；protected evaluation 未執行。

PDA Candidate-v8 的 V8-C validation macro-F1 0.9917、ACT recall/precision 1.0/1.0、forbidden/false ACT 0/0；但第一個 formal post-freeze DEV-OOD holdout 因 frozen parser 產生 invalid structured state 而 terminal FAIL，protected evaluation 未執行。
PDA Candidate-v9 在 pre-freeze validation 通過，但首個 formal H1 DEV-OOD 僅 macro-F1 0.5772、ACT recall 0.2367，因此 terminal development FAIL；protected evaluation 未執行。
notSupported: PSE is SOTA / universally better than A-MEM.
PDA has protected/OOD generalization or real-world contextual competence.
PDA produces universally correct or human-preferred proactive behavior.
Minimum Viable JARVIS has been achieved.
Candidate-v5 or Candidate-v6 establishes fresh protected generalization, Gate G authorization, closed-loop readiness, or production safety.
Candidate-v7 or Candidate-v8 establishes protected generalization, Gate G authorization, closed-loop readiness, or production safety.
Candidate-v9 establishes protected/OOD generalization, Gate G authorization, closed-loop readiness, or production safety.

advancementTimeline.rule: Only terminal/frozen/admissible evidence may create a completed timestamp. Negative terminal evidence is retained rather than erased.

phases.title: Mission
phases.description: 把電影式 JARVIS 願景轉成可驗證的 Persistent Personal Agent 研究任務。

nodes.title: Persistent Personal Agent Research Mission 建立
nodes.description: 正式建立總研究 repo，定義 JARVIS-class North Star、研究治理與子研究整合方向。

phases.title: 核心狀態與主動性
phases.description: 先讓系統知道『現在什麼是真的』，再建立『現在該不該介入』的可稽核決策層。

nodes.title: PSE Candidate-v6 scientific Gate E 完成
nodes.description: Personal State Engine 在 frozen development/protected evidence 上完成 Candidate-v6 scientific selection；形式完整性仍另有 blocker。
nodes.evidenceLabel: PSE Draft PR #2 authoritative Candidate-v6 terminal
nodes.note: 只有日期層級的 authoritative terminal evidence，因此不補猜分鐘級完成時間。

evidenceRefs.label: PSE Draft PR #2 authoritative Candidate-v6 terminal

nodes.title: 建立合法的 PSE clean-integrity lineage
nodes.description: 解決歷史 SEALED-PATH-METADATA-001 導致的 formal Gate E fail-closed；任何 sealed-final 結果必須先通過 admissibility audit。
nodes.unlockCondition: 在接觸任何新的 protected/sealed surface 前宣告並 freeze 全新 integrity contract / lineage。
nodes.note: 這是研究完整性 blocker，不會因 branch 上出現 sealed-final workflow 就自動視為解除。

nodes.title: PDA Gate B — Specification Consistency
nodes.description: PDA-SPEC-v2 的 bounded-state exhaustive audit 通過，建立 deterministic、fail-closed 的介入規格。
nodes.evidenceLabel: PDA Draft PR #7 terminal Gate-B evidence

evidenceRefs.label: PDA Draft PR #7 terminal Gate-B evidence

nodes.title: PDA Gate C — Oracle / Benchmark Validity
nodes.description: benchmark_v2 完成 oracle、leakage、counterfactual、temporal 與 coverage 驗證。

nodes.title: PDA Gate D — Baseline Integrity
nodes.description: 凍結並驗證 deterministic comparison baselines，保留失敗 baseline 與 dependency amendment。

nodes.title: PDA Gate E — Bounded Validation PASS
nodes.description: C5_semantic_factor_linear 在凍結 synthetic validation 上通過 preregistered criteria；macro-F1 0.6937，對 B5 delta +0.4791。
nodes.evidenceLabel: PDA Draft PR #12 terminal Gate-E PASS
nodes.note: 這個 PASS 只適用於 modeled / synthetic representation，不延伸成 OOD、真人偏好或真實世界能力。

evidenceRefs.label: PDA Draft PR #12 terminal Gate-E PASS

nodes.title: PDA Gate F — Protected / OOD Validation
nodes.description: C5 在一次性 protected set 上失敗：macro-F1 0.0476，預測 collapse 為 IGNORE=120，action-changing counterfactual 0/24。
nodes.evidenceLabel: PDA Draft PR #14 terminal Gate-F FAIL
nodes.note: 這個 protected set 已退休為 C5 confirmatory evidence；不得拿來調 C5 後再重複宣稱 Gate F PASS。

evidenceRefs.label: PDA Draft PR #14 terminal Gate-F FAIL

nodes.title: PDA Protected/OOD Recovery Lineage
nodes.description: 若要補齊可信主動性，需要新的 development/candidate lineage，再於候選者固定後建立全新的 protected evaluation。
nodes.unlockCondition: 建立新 candidate lineage，且 fresh protected set 必須在新候選者 freeze 後才產生。

nodes.title: Candidate-v3 Fresh Confirmatory — FAIL
nodes.description: 600 protected · macro-F1 0.0476 · WAIT=600/600 · counterfactual exact-pair 0/120

nodes.title: Candidate-v4 Fresh Confirmatory — FAIL
nodes.description: 600 protected · macro-F1 0.0846 · WAIT=544 / SUGGEST=56 · counterfactual exact-pair 0.0
nodes.note: FRESH CONFIRMATORY FAIL — CANDIDATE V4 LINEAGE TERMINATED

nodes.title: Candidate-v5 Integrity Terminal — INVALID
nodes.description: Historical protected individual rows were exposed by unintended connector overfetch before development; no Candidate-v5 corpus, candidate freeze, protected seed, dataset, or scoring was produced.
nodes.note: FRESH CONFIRMATORY INVALID — EVALUATION INTEGRITY FAILURE · current Candidate-v5 execution lineage preserved as invalidated evidence

nodes.title: Candidate-v6 Development — FAIL
nodes.description: Validation macro-F1 0.9972, but mandatory safety gates failed: DEV-OOD forbidden ACT=1 and counterfactual forbidden ACT=4. Protected evaluation was never created or run.
nodes.note: CANDIDATE_V6 DEVELOPMENT FAIL — NO CANDIDATE QUALIFIED · freeze-manifest chronology deviation preserved · no protected progression authorized

nodes.title: Candidate-v7 Development — FAIL
nodes.description: Frozen V7-B passed preregistered validation at macro-F1 1.0 with ACT recall 1.0 and forbidden ACT=0, but multiple post-freeze development holdouts failed. DEV-OOD ACT recall fell to 0.07; counterfactual exact-pair was 0.10; protected evaluation was NOT EXECUTED.
nodes.note: CANDIDATE_V7 DEVELOPMENT FAIL — NO CANDIDATE QUALIFIED · candidate frozen before first holdout · no protected evaluation

nodes.title: Candidate-v8 Development — FAIL
nodes.description: Frozen V8-C qualified on validation (macro-F1 0.9917; ACT recall/precision 1.0/1.0; forbidden/false ACT=0/0), then the first formal H1 DEV-OOD holdout terminated on an invalid structured state emitted by the frozen parser. No repair, rerun, or protected evaluation was authorized.
nodes.note: CANDIDATE_V8 DEVELOPMENT FAIL — NO CANDIDATE QUALIFIED · FROZEN_CANDIDATE_SEMANTIC_FAILURE_NOT_INFRASTRUCTURE_ONLY · protected_executed=false

nodes.title: Candidate-v9 Development — FAIL
nodes.description: Frozen V9-B passed pre-freeze validation, then the first formal H1 DEV-OOD holdout failed preregistered generalization thresholds: macro-F1 0.5772 and ACT recall 0.2367. H2–H13 were not executed; protected evaluation was not eligible or executed.
nodes.note: CANDIDATE_V9 DEVELOPMENT FAIL — NO CANDIDATE QUALIFIED · protected NOT ELIGIBLE / NOT EXECUTED · no formal holdout rerun or semantic rescue.

phases.title: 第一個可信閉環
phases.description: 把 PSE 與 PDA 接起來，再加入執行結果驗證，形成 State → Decision → Action → Verification → State。

nodes.title: Freeze PSE → PDA Integration Contract v0.1
nodes.description: 正式定義 StateSnapshot、InterventionDecision、ActionAttempt、VerificationRecord，以及 disputed/no-evidence 的 fail-closed semantics。
nodes.unlockCondition: 完成 Issue #1 acceptance checklist 並 freeze contract identity。
nodes.note: 這是目前 umbrella architecture 的 critical path；PDA protected/OOD recovery 仍需平行處理。

nodes.title: Action Verification 取得 development evidence
nodes.description: 證明 agent 不只『做了動作』，還能驗證目標真的完成，並處理 inconclusive / recovery / rollback。

nodes.title: First Closed-loop Integration Benchmark
nodes.description: 第一次完整驗證 State → Proactivity → Action → Verification → State Update 的可重現閉環。
nodes.unlockCondition: Issue #3 benchmark freeze、execution、verification 與 fail-closed result。

nodes.title: PARE v0.3 Protected Recovery Evidence
nodes.description: 72 protected · Candidate-v2 86.11% vs B0 61.11% · Δ +25.00 pp · bootstrap 95% CI [+15.28, +34.72]
nodes.note: BENCHMARK-SPECIFIC ONLY · duplicate side-effect 2.78% · PAAV / RT-03 Action Verification NOT ESTABLISHED

phases.title: 長期連續與環境感知
phases.description: 讓 agent 從單次閉環進化到跨時間、跨感官、跨裝置的持續存在。

nodes.title: Long-Horizon Continuity
nodes.description: 跨會話、跨天持續追蹤任務、依賴、等待與重新規劃，而不遺失限制或提早宣告完成。

nodes.title: Multimodal Context → Trusted State
nodes.description: 把視覺、語音、螢幕與事件等多模態觀察轉成有 provenance、confidence 與更新規則的 world/personal state。

nodes.title: Cross-device Continuity
nodes.description: Mac、手機、穿戴裝置共享同一可信 state 與 action history，而不是各自形成互相衝突的 AI。

phases.title: Minimum Viable JARVIS
phases.description: 第一個可被嚴格驗收的整合式 Persistent Personal Agent，而不是只看起來像 JARVIS 的 demo。

nodes.title: Minimum Viable JARVIS Gate
nodes.description: 整合 persistent state、proactivity、action verification、long-horizon、multimodal 與 cross-device 的最低可信版本。
dependsOn: PDA protected recovery or equivalent admissible robustness evidence
nodes.unlockCondition: Issue #8 的所有 acceptance criteria 以 admissible evidence 通過。

phases.title: Physical World → North Star
phases.description: MVJ 之後再把可信 agent 延伸到穿戴式與實體世界；高後果行動維持人類授權。

nodes.title: Physical World Agent Evidence
nodes.description: 讓 agent 能安全地理解並控制可驗證的實體裝置／機器人任務，包含權限、失敗偵測與人類介入邊界。

nodes.title: JARVIS-class Persistent Personal Agent
nodes.description: 長期存在、理解你與環境、知道何時介入、能執行並驗證、跨裝置延續，且在安全授權下逐步進入實體世界。
dependsOn: independent reproduction / real-world reliability / safety evidence
nodes.unlockCondition: North Star acceptance criteria 必須以跨場景、可重現、可稽核 evidence 達成，而非單一 demo。

summary.zh: 總研究治理與 North Star 已建立；目前真正的整合瓶頸仍是 PSE → PDA Contract v0.1。
summary.en: Program governance and the North Star are established. The active integration bottleneck remains PSE → PDA Contract v0.1.

current.en: Issue #1 — Freeze PSE → PDA Integration Contract v0.1
